title: Foreign Fee Return on Takeover Cards — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Tariff Footnote
content:
**Footnote to the foreign transaction fee tariff, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.** On a dispute of a purchase on a *takeover card*, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created, the fee return is worked out from the foreign transaction fees charged on the takeover card:

| Foreign transaction fees charged on the takeover card | Card tier | Fee return |
|---|---|---|
| some | Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit, Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | the whole of those fees |
| some | any other tier: Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit, Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit or Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 50 percent of those fees, rounded to the cent (half up) |
| none | any tier | 0.00 |

*Fees charged on the takeover card* means the total of the foreign transaction fee charges booked on that card's activity. The tier is the takeover card's own tier.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Takeover card | Foreign transaction fees charged | Fee return |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 2.53 and 0.87, totalling 3.40 | 50 percent of 3.40, which is 1.70 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 2.53 | 50 percent of 2.53 is 1.265, so 1.27 (half up) |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 1.20 | 1.20, the whole |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | none | 0.00 |
